atena_pick_up.speaker: Atena
atena_pick_up.text: You can pick up rocks using the LEFT MOUSE button.

atena_pick_up.speaker: Atena
atena_pick_up.text: You can also throw rocks with the LEFT MOUSE button.

atena_pick_up.speaker: Atena
atena_pick_up.text: You can calmly drop rocks with S.

atena_lever.speaker: Atena2
atena_lever.text: Looks like you've encountered some kind of state of the art modern technology?

atena_lever.speaker: Atena2
atena_lever.text: I don't know how much I can help you...

atena_lever.speaker: Atena2
atena_lever.text: But maybe you can pull the lever using the LEFT MOUSE button.
